## Belevico Pods
Belevico Pods are sold in boxes of 10 pods. A box costs ₺189. We currently offer 14 blends, from the mild "Ege Sabahı" (intensity 4) to the strong "Gece Vardiyası" (intensity 12).

# Setting Up Your Machine
## First use
1. Remove all packaging and tape.
2. Rinse the water tank and fill it with fresh, cold water.
3. Plug in the machine and press the power button. The machine heats up in about 25 seconds.
4. Run a rinse cycle: without a pod, press the lungo button twice. Repeat 3 times and discard the water.

## Connecting to the Belevico Home app
The Belevico Home app is available for iOS and Android.

1. Create an account or sign in to the app.
2. Hold the power button for 5 seconds until the light blinks blue.
3. In the app, tap "Add machine" and select your Wi-Fi network.

Belevico machines only connect to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi networks. 5 GHz networks are not supported.

Registering your machine in the app within 30 days of delivery activates Belevico Care+ (one extra year of warranty).

# Cleaning and Descaling
## Daily cleaning
- Empty and rinse the drip tray and used pod container every day.
- Belevico Pods are compostable, so used pods can go into a home compost bin or organic waste.

## Cleaning the LatteCore milk system (Forte only)
LatteCore rinses itself automatically after each milk drink. Once a week, remove the milk carafe and wash all its parts in warm water. The carafe parts are dishwasher-safe on the top rack.

## Descaling
Descale your machine every 3 months, or earlier when the orange drop icon lights up. A blinking red light means descaling is overdue.

Use only Belevico DescalePro (₺159, enough for 2 descaling cycles). Never use vinegar or other descalers: they damage the seals and void your warranty.

1. Make sure your Wi-Fi network is **2.4 GHz**. Belevico machines do not support 5 GHz networks.

3. In the **Belevico Home app** (iOS or Android), create an account or sign in, tap **"Add machine"**, and select your Wi-Fi network.

If the machine doesn't connect, check that the network is 2.4 GHz and restart pairing by holding the power button for 5 seconds again.

Note: Belevico Nomad has no Wi-Fi and doesn't connect to the app. For Nomad, you'd only register its serial number manually in the app to activate Care+.

If you need more help, contact support@belevico.example.

## How to start a return
Start a return from "My Orders" > "Return an item". You will receive a KuşKargo return code by email. Drop the parcel at any KuşKargo branch within 5 days of receiving the code.

## Return shipping costs
- Defective or wrong item: return shipping is free.
- Change of mind: ₺79 return shipping is deducted from your refund.

# Warranty
The warranty does not cover:
- Damage caused by limescale because the machine was not descaled
- Damage caused by using third-party pods
- Damage caused by descaling with vinegar or non-Belevico descaling products
- Drops, liquid spills on the electronics, and other accidental damage
- Normal wear of seals and the drip tray

## How warranty repair works
Contact support with your order number and a short video of the problem. If the issue is covered, we send you a free KuşKargo pickup code. Repairs take about 10 business days at our İzmir repair center.

Belevico Forte owners receive a free loaner machine during the repair. Loaner machines are not available for Aria or Nomad.

# Warranty
## Warranty periods
| Machine | Standard warranty |
|---------|-------------------|
| Belevico Aria | 2 years |
| Belevico Forte | 3 years |
| Belevico Nomad | 1 year |

The warranty starts on the delivery date.

## Belevico Care+
If you register your machine in the Belevico Home app within 30 days of delivery, you get Belevico Care+: one extra year of warranty, free of charge. Machines registered after 30 days do not qualify for Care+.

## What the warranty covers
The warranty covers manufacturing defects in parts and workmanship.

# Returns and Refunds
## Refunds
After the returned item arrives at our İzmir warehouse, we inspect it within 3 business days. Approved refunds are sent within 7 business days after inspection, to the original payment method. For orders paid by bank transfer, we need your IBAN to send the refund.

Your bank may need extra time to show the refund on your card statement.

## Exchanges
We do not offer direct exchanges. Please return the item and place a new order.
